subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI Quick Config — Model & Thinking card save fails silently in 2026.7.1-beta.5

question: Should Quick Config’s Fast mode control edit the default agent’s `agents.list[].fastModeDefault`, the selected model’s `params.fastMode`, or introduce a new global default with explicit precedence?
rationale: Current runtime and documentation have no global `agents.defaults.fastModeDefault` behavior, so accepting the reporter’s proposed schema addition would expose a setting that does nothing unless maintainers intentionally expand the config contract.

options.title: Use Default Agent
options.body: Resolve the configured default agent and edit its existing `agents.list[].fastModeDefault`, preserving current runtime precedence without adding config surface.

options.title: Use Selected Model
options.body: Edit the selected model’s existing `agents.defaults.models[model].params.fastMode`, making the toggle model-scoped.

options.title: Add Global Default
options.body: Introduce `agents.defaults.fastModeDefault` across types, schema, runtime precedence, help, docs, and fresh/upgrade tests as a new public config contract.

recommendation.title: Use Default Agent
recommendation.body: Resolve the configured default agent and edit its existing `agents.list[].fastModeDefault`, preserving current runtime precedence without adding config surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily the intended semantics of the Quick Settings UI he recently maintained.
